The automatic-request rule is governed by I9 in the invariants, not only by a Revises line. I9 states that the on_index hook enqueues a run only for a video that has no run at all, and that no automatic request replaces a run of an older pipeline version or retries a failed one. video_visual.py:555-569: if runs exist and after_scan is false, the reason is run_exists when there is no active run or when the active run has a different pipeline_version. test_video_visual_worker.py:796-799 creates a failed, inactive run with pipeline_version=1 and asserts run_exists. That matches I9 and the SPEC-ADDON-113 item 1 wording in the enqueue docstring (video_visual.py:535-539). The test change follows the declared invariant. It was not a new rule.
